Name: Transmutation OREganization
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
Okay okay okay, you can transmute bars now, that's cool... but has anyone considered the ores? What about them? Don't they matter? Well I think they do, so now you can transmute your ores before you smelt them! I now introduce to you: 

Transmutation OREganization!!!

[b] With this mod you can: [/b]
- Transmute Copper Ore -> Iron Ore [Level 4 Mining]
- Transmute Iron Ore -> Gold Ore [Level 7 Mining]
- Transmute Gold Ore -> Iridium Ore [Level 8 Mining]
- Transmute Iridium Ore -> Radioactive Ore [Level 9 Mining]
[b]DE transmute all ores in reverse:[/b]
- Radioactive ore -> Iridium Ore [Level 8 Mining]
- Iridium Ore -> Gold Ore [Level 7 Mining]
 - Gold Ore -> Iron Ore [Level 4 Mining]
 - Iron Ore -> Copper Ore [Level 2 Mining]

There is also a detailed config where you can disable or enable each type of transmutation, so if you don't want anything to do with radioactive ore, you can simply disable it! 

I really recommend using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GenericModConfigMenu[/url] to configure your game, it makes it far easier to edit the configs.

I also recommend using [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23986]Altro's Blacksmithing Overhaul for Content Patcher[/url] if you want a more "immersive" in game experience to get ores, as well as a way to transmute bars.

Kudos to these people for making mods that do similar things in the past, including my own mod!
